extraction_notes: Electrical characteristics are specified at TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
The capacitance values are transcribed from the MAX column; the table provides no typical values.

omission_reason: No usable electrical curves are present in the supplied three-page PDF. Pages 1 and 2 contain feature, rating, and electrical-characteristics tables, while page 3 is a package outline drawing; therefore no transfer, output, or capacitance-versus-voltage curve points are extracted.
